CRITICAL: Use ONLY the exact data below. Do NOT hardcode vendor/item IDs — always discover them dynamically via API calls first.

AUTH:
- Admin: POST /api/auth/login with {"username":"jose","password":"Password1"} → returns {"token":"..."}
- Standard user: POST /api/auth/login with {"username":"alix","password":"Password1"} → returns {"token":"..."}
- All protected endpoints require header: Authorization: Bearer <token>

DISCOVERING DATA (do this first in every test):
- GET /api/vendors?all=true → returns {"vendors":[...]} — each has id, vendorCode, vendorName
- GET /api/items?page=1&limit=50&all=true → returns {"items":[...],"total":N} — each has id, itemCode, defaultVendorId

ACTUAL DATABASE STATE:
Vendors:
  id=1 code=LIPPERT (has transactions — cannot delete)
  id=2 code=DEXTER (has transactions — cannot delete, is defaultVendor on items AX-12K-EZ, AX-7K-STD)
  id=3 code=TITAN (is defaultVendor on items — cannot delete)
  id=4 code=ACME (is defaultVendor on items — cannot delete)
  id=5 code=V-TEST-1771993642219 (no references — CAN be deleted)
  id=6 code=V-TEST-1771993809824 (has transactions — cannot delete)
  id=7 code=V-001 (no references — CAN be deleted)

Items (sample): AX-12K-EZ (id=3), BR-10-DRUM (id=14), LT-MARKER (id=1)

IMPORTANT TEST INSTRUCTIONS:

TC001 (item check-code):
- First GET /api/items to discover an existing item code and its id
- GET /api/items/check-code?code=<discovered_code> → {exists:true, id:<discovered_id>}
- GET /api/items/check-code?code=<lowercase_version> → should ALSO return {exists:true} (case-insensitive)
- GET /api/items/check-code?code=ZZZZZ-NONEXISTENT → {exists:false, id:null}
- GET /api/items/check-code (no param) → 400

TC002 (vendor next-code):
- V-001 already exists, so GET /api/vendors/next-code?prefix=V- → {nextCode:"V-002"}
- GET /api/vendors/next-code?prefix=NEW- → {nextCode:"NEW-001"} (no NEW- vendors exist)
- GET /api/vendors/next-code (no param) → 400

TC003 (vendor check-code):
- First GET /api/vendors to discover vendor codes and ids
- GET /api/vendors/check-code?code=<discovered_code> → {exists:true, id:<discovered_id>}
- GET /api/vendors/check-code?code=<lowercase_version> → should ALSO return {exists:true} (case-insensitive)
- GET /api/vendors/check-code?code=ZZZZZ-NONEXISTENT → {exists:false, id:null}
- GET /api/vendors/check-code (no param) → 400

TC004 (vendor hard delete):
- Use admin token for all delete attempts
- First create a fresh vendor: POST /api/vendors {"vendorCode":"DEL-TEST-001","vendorName":"Delete Test"} → get its id
- DELETE /api/vendors/<new_id> → 200 {message:"Vendor \"DEL-TEST-001\" permanently deleted."}
- Try deleting a referenced vendor (discover one with defaultVendorId references by checking items): DELETE → 400 with error message
- DELETE /api/vendors/99999 → 404
- Use STANDARD USER token: DELETE /api/vendors/<any_id> → 403 {error:"Admin access required"}

TC005 (item create case-insensitive):
- POST /api/items {"itemCode":"test-case-item","description":"Test","unitOfMeasure":"EA"} → 201, itemCode in response should be "TEST-CASE-ITEM" (uppercased)
- POST /api/items {"itemCode":"TEST-CASE-ITEM","description":"Dup","unitOfMeasure":"EA"} → 409 conflict
- POST /api/items {"itemCode":"Test-Case-Item","description":"Dup2","unitOfMeasure":"EA"} → 409 conflict
- Clean up: DELETE /api/items/<created_id> after test

TC006 (vendor create case-insensitive):
- POST /api/vendors {"vendorCode":"test-case-vnd","vendorName":"Test Vendor"} → 201, vendorCode should be "TEST-CASE-VND"
- POST /api/vendors {"vendorCode":"TEST-CASE-VND","vendorName":"Dup"} → 409 conflict
- POST /api/vendors {"vendorCode":"Test-Case-Vnd","vendorName":"Dup2"} → 409 conflict
- Clean up: DELETE /api/vendors/<created_id> after test
